dedupe_keys.name: virtual antenna array based channel sounding at 300 ghz implementation and field measurements

description: Aalborg University researchers publish measured antenna patterns and channel frequency responses for a 300 GHz virtual-array experiment. The May 2025 Zenodo deposit supplies four MATLAB files and documentation, freely available under CC BY 4.0. Measurements cover 295–305 GHz in an entrance hall, with a fixed fifteen-dBi transmit horn and two receive horns having different beamwidths. The receiver sweeps a 9.5-centimetre-radius virtual array in 0.3-degree steps, with a 6.5-metre transmitter–receiver separation and 1.25-metre antenna heights. The response files contain magnitude, phase and frequency information. These observations can calibrate directional indoor-channel simulations for prospective communication systems. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the collection. Acquisition dates, building identity, repeated-run counts and measurement uncertainty remain unknown from the README. The setup describes one geometry and should not represent arbitrary indoor halls. MAT files were not downloaded.
